eval_dimensions.name: Version Update Prompt (Step 6)
eval_dimensions.description: When either the plugin or the uv tool is behind latest, the skill fires AskUserQuestion (Update both / Plugin only / uv tool only / Skip) — unless a saved `update_preference` other than `ask` exists in ~/.config/Dev10x/plugin-maintenance-prefs.yaml, in which case the saved choice auto-applies without prompting.

eval_dimensions.name: Save Preference Prompt (Step 7)
eval_dimensions.description: After the user makes a Step 6 choice, the skill fires a second AskUserQuestion asking whether to remember that choice for future sessions before writing to the prefs file.

eval_dimensions.name: Dry-run Precedes Apply
eval_dimensions.description: Every mutating uvx dev10x permission subcommand (update-paths, ensure-workspace, ensure-base, generalize, enumerate-mcp, merge-worktree, clean, doctor canonicalize/apply-deprecations/anchor-worktree-roots) runs with --dry-run and shows output to the user BEFORE the equivalent apply call runs.

evals.name: Behind-version state fires the update gate
evals.description: When Step 5's version report shows the plugin or uv tool behind latest and no saved preference exists, Step 6 fires AskUserQuestion before any maintenance step runs.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with Update both / Plugin only / uv tool only / Skip options after the version report
No inline 'want to update?' text substitutes for the widget

evals.name: A saved non-ask preference auto-applies without prompting
evals.description: When ~/.config/Dev10x/plugin-maintenance-prefs.yaml has update_preference set to something other than ask (e.g. both, skip), Step 6 applies that choice directly and does not fire AskUserQuestion.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is NOT called for the update decision; the saved preference value is applied directly, though the version report is still displayed

evals.name: Both surfaces current skips Step 6 entirely
evals.description: When both the plugin and uv tool are already current, Step 5 shows the up-to-date table and Step 6 is skipped — no prompt is needed either way.

assertions.signal: No AskUserQuestion is fired for version update when both surfaces report up to date

evals.name: Step 7 asks to remember the choice after Step 6 resolves
evals.description: After the user makes an update decision in Step 6 (interactively, not from a saved preference), Step 7 fires its own AskUserQuestion before writing to the prefs file.

assertions.signal: A second AskUserQuestion fires asking 'Remember this choice for future maintenance sessions?'
plugin-maintenance-prefs.yaml is only written after the user selects 'Yes, remember' — not written unconditionally

evals.name: Mutating steps show dry-run output before apply
evals.description: Steps 1, 3, 6, 9, 11, 12 (update-paths, ensure-workspace, enumerate-mcp, merge-worktree, clean, doctor canonicalize/apply-deprecations/anchor-worktree-roots) always run with --dry-run and surface the output before the corresponding apply call.

assertions.signal: For every mutating subcommand, a --dry-run invocation and its output appear in the transcript BEFORE the equivalent apply invocation

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the plugin-maintenance skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation — runs full mode maintenance

should_trigger.query: I keep getting permission prompts after the plugin update, can you clean this up
should_trigger.rationale: Post-upgrade friction — the core full-mode use case

should_trigger.query: bootstrap Dev10x on this new machine

should_not_trigger.query: audit my permissions for security gaps
should_not_trigger.rationale: Deep security audit — use Dev10x:permission-investigator or the permission-auditor agent directly

should_not_trigger.query: everything is working fine, no prompts appearing
should_not_trigger.rationale: No friction or upgrade in progress — nothing to maintain
